# vendor/ — user-fetched upstream tapes

Users drop TUHS-fetched V8/V9/V10 tapes here. `.gitignore` excludes
tarballs so upstream source never enters git.

Recommended layout:

    vendor/
    ├── v8/    <-- Dan Cross V8 restoration
    ├── v9/    <-- Norman v9 batterpudding
    └── v10/   <-- Norman v10 milligan + Dan Cross v10
